description: This file defines an abstract class 'SimpleMapOperation' used for performing operations on a specific field within a mapping process, including handling error messages and localization.

classes.name: SimpleMapOperation
classes.description: An abstract class representing a single operation on a field, with mechanisms for error message handling and localization.

methods.name: SimpleMapOperation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on XML element configuration and the process context.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field this operation targets.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds an error or informational message to the messages list, supporting localization and property-based messages.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the operation, to be implemented by subclasses.
